title: Nephropathy 1 Formula (N1F) mitigates cisplatin-induced acute kidney injury by inhibiting TAK1-dependent NF-kappaB signaling.
authors: Wang, Xilong; Lin, Yangjing; Wang, Ziqiong; Jiang, Zhibin; Jin, Dian; Ma, Shuqing; Yuan, Jixiang; Zhang, Yin; Pan, Xiaodong; Zhu, Liting; Cheng, Jinguo; Bai, Yongheng; Cai, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方N1F通过抑制TAK1-NF-kappaB信号缓解顺铂肾损伤，虽涉及分子对接但核心为药效与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Nephropathy 1 Formula (N1F) derives from the classical traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) prescription Biejia Jian Wan ("Turtle Carapace Pill"). Rooted in the TCM collateral disease theory, N1F has been clinically used for more than a decade at The First Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University to protect renal function. Its therapeutic principles are closely associated with renal microinflammation and fibrosis. AIM OF THE STUDY: The present study aimed to evaluate the protective effects of N1F against cisplatin-induced acute kidney injury (AKI) and elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms, with a particular focus on transforming growth factor-beta-activated kinase 1 (TAK1)-dependent nuclear factor (NF)-kappaB signaling and active phytochemical identification. METHODS: Cisplatin-challenged C57BL/6 mice were treated with N1F, followed by assessments of renal function, tubular pathology, apoptosis, and inflammation. Mechanistic studies employed HK-2 cells with TAK1 overexpression or inhibition. western blotting, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays, and immunofluorescence analyses were used to investigate pathway activity. Liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectroscopy profiling integrated with machine learning and molecular docking was used to identify potential TAK1-binding compounds. RESULTS: N1F significantly improved renal function and alleviated tubular injury in cisplatin-challenged mice, accompanied by the marked suppression of inflammatory responses and apoptosis. Mechanistically, N1F inhibited the phosphorylation of TAK1, IKKbeta, and IKBalpha, thereby preventing NF-kappaB p65 nuclear translocation. Consistently, the expression of kidney injury markers (Kim-1 and NGAL) and pro-inflammatory cytokines (interleukin (IL)-1beta, IL-6, and tumor necrosis factor-alpha) was significantly reduced. Ginsenoside Rg1, saikosaponin D, saikosaponin B2, ginsenoside F2, and Rg6 were identified as potential TAK1 ligands. CONCLUSIONS: N1F was shown to alleviate cisplatin-induced AKI primarily by inhibiting TAK1-NF-kappaB signaling. Ginsenosides and saikosaponins are likely to represent key bioactive components contributing to their renoprotective effects.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：肾病1号方（N1F）源自经典中药（TCM）方剂鳖甲煎丸（“龟甲丸”）。基于中医络病理论，N1F已在温州医科大学附属第一医院临床使用十余年，用于保护肾功能。其治疗原则与肾脏微炎症和纤维化密切相关。研究目的：本研究旨在评估N1F对顺铂诱导的急性肾损伤（AKI）的保护作用，并阐明其潜在分子机制，特别关注转化生长因子-β激活激酶1（TAK1）依赖性核因子（NF）-κB信号通路及活性植物化学物质鉴定。方法：对顺铂攻击的C57BL/6小鼠给予N1F治疗，随后评估肾功能、肾小管病理、凋亡和炎症。机制研究采用TAK1过表达或抑制的HK-2细胞。使用蛋白质印迹法、定量实时聚合酶链反应、酶联免疫吸附测定和免疫荧光分析来研究通路活性。液相色谱-串联质谱分析结合机器学习和分子对接用于鉴定潜在的TAK1结合化合物。结果：N1F显著改善了顺铂攻击小鼠的肾功能并减轻了肾小管损伤，同时伴随炎症反应和凋亡的显著抑制。机制上，N1F抑制了TAK1、IKKβ和IKBα的磷酸化，从而阻止NF-κB p65核转位。一致地，肾损伤标志物（Kim-1和NGAL）和促炎细胞因子（白细胞介素（IL）-1β、IL-6和肿瘤坏死因子-α）的表达显著降低。人参皂苷Rg1、柴胡皂苷D、柴胡皂苷B2、人参皂苷F2和Rg6被鉴定为潜在的TAK1配体。结论：N1F主要通过抑制TAK1-NF-κB信号通路减轻顺铂诱导的AKI。人参皂苷和柴胡皂苷可能代表其肾保护作用的关键生物活性成分。
